question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Triumph
solution:
The correct answer is **Defeat**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Triumph **means a great victory or achievement. (एक महान विजय या उपलब्धि)

 
 
• **For example-** *The championships proved to be a personal triumph for the coach.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Defeat **means to lose or be beaten in a competition or battle. (किसी प्रतियोगिता या युद्ध में हारना या पराजित होना)
 
 
• **For example-** *He lost his job after a shock defeat at the local elections in June.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that 'Triumph' and 'Defeat' are **antonyms **as they are opposite in meaning.
 
• Triumph is a noun, while Defeat is a verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Capture **means to take someone or something by force or skill. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को बलपूर्वक या कौशल से लेना)
 
• **Attainment **means the action of achieving a goal or objective. (किसी लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने की क्रिया)
 
• **Succeed **means to achieve a desired aim or result. (किसी वांछित लक्ष्य या परिणाम को प्राप्त करना)
